verdict.rationale: Make documents recurring scheduling: a 'schedule a scenario' help page exists, and webhook queues can be processed periodically, 'every time your schedule criteria are met.' The evidence is thin, though. The scheduling page shows up only as a navigation title, and nothing shows that the recurrence can be configured through the API or MCP server. missing for 10: detailed docs on schedule options (intervals, cron-like timing), evidence that schedules can be created or changed via the API/MCP for AI-native workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: you can schedule your to process all webhook requests periodically
the whole queue is then processed every time your schedule criteria are met
